summary: Iter62 full test of Luchii Code nav/model-pair fix + new Frasberg Game Builder (prompt->rules->WorldDefinition->real engines) + Frasberg Image XL + regressions. 19/19 backend pytest pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iter62_game_builder.py). Frontend: nav-luchii-code and footer-luchii-code-link both point to /chat?model=luchii-7b&agent=builder. All four workspace agent URLs show correct header + workspace-model-select value — critically /chat?model=luchii-7b&agent=builder correctly shows 'Luchii Builder · Code generation · Luchii-7b' with dropdown on 'builder' EVEN AFTER visiting architect first (localStorage override bug is fixed). Changing dropdown navigates to /chat?model=<tier>&agent=<key> correctly for all 4 pairs. Game Builder UI at /game-builder (logged in): game-mode-toggle with engine (default) + ai modes; all 7 engine chips (auto + racer3d + streets + carjack + dungeon3d + spaceshooter + maze3d); building 'neon night street race 3 laps pink traffic' produced racer3d world named 'Night Las Vegas Racer' with engine-world-panel, play iframe, 10 tunable sliders, time + weather selects, save and JSON-toggle. Switching to AI mode hides engine-prompt. /games library includes 'carjack' and /api/games/carjack/play loads. GET /api/creator/gpu/v1/engines includes 'frasberg-image-xl'. Backend rule engine correctly maps all 6 prompts (racer3d, carjack $5000, spaceshooter 7 lives + bossEvery 3, dungeon3d 12 enemies, maze3d 'Mist Hollow', streets startCash 900). engine param forces engine, unknown engine->400, unauth->401, enriched_by='rules' when Frasberg upstream unreachable (as expected per user choice). PATCH clamps config (maxSpeed 9999 -> 120), rejects unknown config key with 400, sets time_of_day/weather. GET /play returns engine HTML with window.FRASBERG_WORLD injected and /api/games/assets/world.js. Game-builder worlds also surface in /api/v1/worldgraph payload (same owner). DELETE removes world and subsequent GET -> 404.
critical_code_review_comments: game_world_builder.py pick_engine fallback uses index tiebreak that favors spaceshooter when no keywords hit at all and no car/shoot cues — fine for current prompts but worth documenting the default-fallback behaviour.

PATCH /api/game-builder/worlds/{id} updates the engine component props in scenes[0].components but does not revalidate against the full WorldDefinition pydantic model after mutation — if a future config key clashes with a required WD invariant it won't be caught. Not critical today because _clamp enforces the tunable allow-list.
frasberg_complete logs 'Frasberg server unreachable' at INFO on every world creation when upstream is down — noisy, consider log-once or DEBUG.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (navbar, 4 agent URLs, dropdown nav, game-builder engine mode, AI toggle, games library)
